abstract:
Letmeet is a system that help the user reserve the meeting room. It facilitates the user to search and reserve a meeting room. The user could register to the system, they can access and modify their account by singing in.

The user account could maintain the participant and manager detail, with their reservation and meeting information. Moreover, they can view their meeting invitation and meeting history in their own user menu. Team function also provided in this system.

The manager can make a reservation and invite participant to the meeting. Manager is one who can create a team for meeting and add member to the team. So, participant could be added to the team by manager. Also, they can cancel reservation, update and delete team.

The system admin can add meeting room to the system. They can verify the user account when the user register to the system. System Admin can also view meeting room summary and reports graph to help them take decision.

abstract: As the economy grows, people are increasingly looking for quality of life. Many families and individuals need to buy cars. The demand for cars is increasing year after year. Since the mid-1990s, the development of e-commerce has attracted the world's attention. Many companies have used the internet, a powerful e-commerce platform, to create web pages and applications for online car transactions. Currently, most automotive markets have a complex sales process. The process usually involves the user entering the sales module and manually entering the make, model, and other relevant information about the car before the sales process can be completed and the sale recorded. This sales process is too cumbersome and degrades the user experience. This project proposes a method that uses a vehicle identification number or image to identify the car and automatically fill in the information. This approach effectively reduces the user entry process, optimizes the sales process, and improves the user experience.

The fuel and gasoline industry plays an important role in the world's Gross Domestic Product by providing energy resources fuel and gas companies require high operational efficiency in order to maintain profits. Because of the oil global economic framework, impacting everything from transportation to heating & electricity to industrial production & manufacturing. Service station business at this time, not only managing or thinking about a business strategy to be profitable, but it also includes the management of fuel storage and there are a lot of problems occurring during this business.

FSRS is a recommender system that focuses on recommending the gasoline and fuel stock as a solution to predict future purchases to appropriate the fuel stock situation for service station operators to be easier to manage business.

canonical_title: Computerized Control of Selective Perception in the Study of 'Boring' Subjects
advisor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract: As a result of COVID-19, online learning is increasingly promoted and used for teaching and learning. The effectiveness of online learning is one of the main concerns of many people. Selective perception refers to the way people perceive certain information that they want to perceive through mediated information while automatically ignoring other, contrary information. Students' selective perceptions make it difficult to concentrate on learning, especially in 'boring' subjects. Students are often distracted during lectures or other learning activities. Gamification and Rewards can directly alter people's processing of specific stimuli and increase their attentional priority. Research has shown that gamification and rewards play a very important role in students' selective cognition. It can motivate students to learn and effectively improve their perception of learning. Integrating gamification and rewards into online learning can increase students' motivation and attention. This report references improving online teaching and learning, especially in 'boring' subjects.
